issue_ledger.summary: The frozen report schema accepts any string for session_header.phase, the worker HMAC message does not include report phase, and validate_branch_bus.py never compares report session_header.phase with assignment.phase. A wrong-phase otherwise-valid worker report can therefore satisfy the frozen branch-validator phase-related checks and remain auth-valid.
issue_ledger.fix_or_next: Add an explicit branch-validator equality check session_header.phase == assignment.phase and keep a schema-valid wrong-phase negative mutation in MM06 verification. Do not rely on the HMAC as content authentication because its frozen message binds plan/cohort/control/assignment/worker, not report fields.
